item.description:
## Highlights
- **Fixed: follow-up turns no longer rejected after a long prefill.** One successful long request could leave the adaptive memory budget with an inflated activation reserve, so chat clients saw repeated `generation context exceeds available GPU wired memory` failures until the app restarted. The reserve now resolves at the planned chunk scope and every projection is capped at the configured memory ceiling. - **Enabled: OptiQ sidecar multi-token prediction.** Compatible Qwen artifacts with OptiQ MTP metadata can opt in to multi-token prediction through `acceleration.mtp.enabled`, with per-model draft depth. - **Fixed: multi-row GPU sampling bugs** in the OptiQ path.
## Compatibility
- Requires macOS 14.0 or later on Apple Silicon. - Existing configurations, model libraries, downloads, and the persistent prompt cache are preserved by the update.
## Distribution
- Signed with Developer ID Application, notarized and stapled by Apple, and distributed as a signed disk image. - The Sparkle update feed is signed; existing installations update in place through the app's menu.
